description: This Java class 'ContentUrlTag' provides utility methods to generate URL prefixes for content, considering security (HTTP/HTTPS) and website-specific configurations, by reading properties and request headers.

classes.name: ContentUrlTag
classes.description: Utility class for appending content URL prefixes based on request, website configuration, and properties.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix
methods.description: Appends the appropriate content URL prefix to a StringBuilder or Appendable, based on request and website configuration.

methods.name: getContentPrefix
methods.description: Returns the content URL prefix as a String based on the request context.
